busy: Please wait for the current operation to finish.
nothingToSave: There is nothing to save yet: import some frames first.
newProject: New project: import your frames to get started.
unreadableFile: The project file could not be read.
recovered: Work recovered. Save it to keep it.
recoveredInProject: Work recovered in project “{name}”. Save it to keep it.

notices.imageMissing: the image saved in the project could not be found: the original frame has been reopened and you will need to apply the processing again
notices.originalMissing: the original image could not be found: Reset will return to the processed image
notices.missingFramesOne: 1 frame is no longer on disk (the first: {first}). The project still remembers it: if you reconnect the drive, it will come back when you reopen the project
notices.missingFramesOther: {count} frames are no longer on disk (the first: {first}). The project still remembers them: if you reconnect the drive, they will come back when you reopen the project
notices.masksUnreadableOne: a painted mask could not be read: its local adjustment now applies without it
notices.masksUnreadableOther: {count} painted masks could not be read: their local adjustments now apply without them
notices.drizzleNotRestored: the scale and astrometric solution of the drizzle could not be restored: markers and measurements will use those of the frame
notices.mosaicNotRestored: the scale and astrometric solution of the mosaic could not be restored: markers and measurements will use those of the frame
